banner.title: Cookies and third-party content
banner.body: Bookparking sets no advertising or audience-measurement cookies. Two outside services wait for your consent: the map, served by OpenStreetMap, and the fonts, served by Google. They receive your IP address when they load.

settings.title: Cookies and third-party content
settings.intro: Choose what you allow. Your choice is kept for six months in this browser, and can be changed at any time from “Manage cookies”, at the bottom of every page.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.body: Your sign-in session and this choice, kept in this browser: without them, the site would not know who is signed in. Address search queries the Base Adresse Nationale, a French public service, as you type.

map.label: Map (OpenStreetMap)
map.body: The search map background, served by the OpenStreetMap Foundation. If refused, the list of spaces stays complete: only the map is not shown.

fonts.label: Fonts (Google Fonts)
fonts.body: The site’s typefaces, served by Google. If refused, the site uses your device’s fonts.

mapPlaceholder.title: The map is waiting for your consent
mapPlaceholder.body: It is served by OpenStreetMap, which receives your IP address when it loads. The list of spaces works without it.
mapPlaceholder.hint: You can withdraw this choice from “Manage cookies”, at the bottom of the page.
